en.rec: Lights out 00:44, up at 06:05 — 5h 08m asleep inside 5h 21m in bed. The shortest night of the window by 1h 36m, and score 68 is the window low against 84, 74, 84, 82, 82, 81. The cause is not mysterious: wake time barely moved (06:05 against 06:25 yesterday) while bedtime slid from 23:33 to 00:44, so the entire 1h 36m came off the front of the night. Bedtimes across the window read 23:20, 21:30, 23:29, 22:35, 23:08, 23:33, 00:44 — last night is the outlier by more than an hour. What the body protected is worth noting. Deep sleep held at 100 minutes, one under the window high of 101 and effectively unchanged from last night despite losing a quarter of the night's length. That is 32% of the night against a typical 20–25%, the highest deep fraction on the chart, and deep now reads 73, 93, 101, 61, 65, 101, 100 across the seven nights. Everything else absorbed the cut. REM collapsed to 50 minutes from 85 — the window low by 35 minutes, against a run of 87, 147, 111, 90, 98, 85. Light sleep fell to 158 minutes, also the window low. Efficiency stayed respectable at 96% with 13 minutes awake. The autonomics have now drifted for a third straight night. HRV came in at 34, level with last night and three under the 37 seven-night average, making 33, 34, 34 the longest soft run on the chart after an opening pair of 42s. RHR moved for the first time: 55 this morning, up 2 from 53, at the top of the 53–55 band it has held all week. Morning stress reads 26. Readiness 62, low — short sleep, a thinned REM night, a flat HRV and a nudged-up RHR all pointing the same way. Yesterday's first gym session in fourteen days finished at 17:45 and the late night followed it; that combination, not the training itself, is what this morning is showing. One night before 23:00 should be enough to reset it.

hr.rec: Gašenje svjetla u 00:44, ustajanje u 06:05 — 5h 08m sna unutar 5h 21m u krevetu. Najkraća noć u prozoru, i to za 1h 36m, a ocjena 68 je minimum prozora naspram 84, 74, 84, 82, 82, 81. Uzrok nije zagonetan: vrijeme buđenja jedva se pomaknulo (06:05 naspram jučerašnjih 06:25), dok je odlazak na spavanje skliznuo s 23:33 na 00:44, pa je cijelih 1h 36m otpalo s početka noći. Lijeganja kroz prozor idu 23:20, 21:30, 23:29, 22:35, 23:08, 23:33, 00:44 — sinoć odskače za više od sat vremena. Vrijedi primijetiti što je tijelo zaštitilo. Duboki san zadržao se na 100 minuta, jedna ispod vrhunca prozora od 101 i praktički nepromijenjen u odnosu na prethodnu noć, unatoč gubitku četvrtine duljine noći. To je 32% noći naspram uobičajenih 20–25%, najveći udio dubokog sna na grafu, a duboki san sada kroz sedam noći ide 73, 93, 101, 61, 65, 101, 100. Sve ostalo je podnijelo rez. REM je pao na 50 minuta s 85 — minimum prozora, i to za 35 minuta, naspram niza 87, 147, 111, 90, 98, 85. Lagani san pao je na 158 minuta, također minimum prozora. Učinkovitost je ostala solidnih 96% uz 13 minuta budnosti. Autonomika sada odstupa treću noć zaredom. HRV je 34, isto kao prethodne noći i tri ispod sedmodnevnog prosjeka od 37, čime 33, 34, 34 postaje najdulji mlaki niz na grafu nakon uvodnog para od 42. RHR se prvi put pomaknuo: 55 jutros, dva više od 53, na vrhu raspona 53–55 u kojem se držao cijeli tjedan. Jutarnji stres pokazuje 26. Spremnost 62, niska — kratak san, stanjena REM noć, ravan HRV i podignut RHR svi pokazuju u istom smjeru. Jučerašnji prvi trening u teretani nakon četrnaest dana završio je u 17:45, a kasna noć je uslijedila; ta kombinacija, a ne sam trening, ono je što ovo jutro pokazuje. Jedna noć s lijeganjem prije 23:00 trebala bi to vratiti na svoje.
